scheme_name: Free Motorized Tricycle Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must have good eyesight, mental capacity, and sufficient upper‑body strength to operate the tricycle while seated
Applicant must not have previously received a motorized tricycle from any government or government‑funded source
Only one benefit can be received per eligible person
benefits_summary: Provides a free motorized tricycle up to a maximum grant of ₹25,000 per eligible person with disability; any cost beyond this amount is borne by the beneficiary.
